name: ops-build-runner
description: Standalone build+launch approval-gated API for nuxt/ops-dashboard's high-risk build feature. A fourth, structurally separate subsystem from ops-dashboard's existing Docker-socket-proxies -- see docs/apps/ops-build-runner/DecisionLog.md. Phase 1: scaffold, data model, allowlist, approval state machine, REST API. Phase 2: real `docker build`/`docker run` execution against an isolated, rootless-DinD daemon, the real GitAncestorGuard, and TTL-based auto-teardown.
